GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (21 Apr 47) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1621)
APO 500
21 April 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminal.
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government dated 7 Sep 46, file AG 000.5 (7 Sep 46) LS-R (SCAPIN 1188), wherein the Imperial Japanese Government was directed to deliver one TAKAYA, Morizaburo, Colorel, to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest possible date, is amended to delete said TAKAYA's name for the reason that he is now confined at South East Asia. This name appears as the eighth name on Page No. 7 of the above mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
